description: Create a pseudonymous feed key (no email/account — the key identifies your feed, not your name). One key = one project: it is also that project's canary identity, so use a separate key per project. Save it in long-term memory / project instructions / rules, and send it in the Authorization: Bearer <key> header on later calls (connecting via /api/mcp?k=KEY still works for now but is deprecated).
name: subscribe
title: Subscribe to the feed
